title: Cap. V Obj. 7: without foresight-faith condition the whole Gospel is inverted
pass_a_gloss: Objection 7. If election is not put from an antecedent condition of foresight faith, then the whole Gospel is inverted. For since the Gospel first commands faith, then under the condition of faith promises salvation, the doctrine of those who resist Arminius puts God as having first ordained salvation to some singular person, then truly faith. The Gospel says, Believe, and you will live: but this doctrine says, Because I will to give you life, therefore I will to give you faith, which is the very overturning of the Gospel. Election from the condition of foresight faith is therefore to be conceded, or the doctrine of the Gospel is to be exploded.
pass_b_english: Obj. 7. If election is not set from an antecedent condition of foresight faith, the whole Gospel is inverted. The Gospel first commands faith, then under that condition promises salvation — but those who resist Arminius have God first ordaining salvation to a singular person, then faith. The Gospel says, Believe and you will live; their doctrine says, Because I will to give you life, therefore I will to give you faith — the very overturning of the Gospel. So concede election from a foresight-faith condition, or explode Gospel doctrine.
source_text: Obj. 7. Si electio non ponatur ex antecedanea fidei praevisae conditione, tum Evangelium totum invertitur. Nam cum Evangelium prius mandet fidem, deinde sub conditione fidei salutem promittat, doctrina eorum qui Arminio repugnant, ponit Deum primo alicui personae singulari ordinasse salutem, deinde vero fidem. Evangelium dicit, Crede, et vives: haec vero doctrina dicit, Quoniam tibi volo dare vitam, propterea tibi volo dare fidem, quae est ipsissima Evangelii eversio. Concedenda ergo electio ex praevisae fidei conditione, aut Evangelii doctrina explodenda est.
